formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Variable and Constant
formulas.formula: A variable is a letter that stands for a number; a constant is a fixed number.

formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Algebraic Expression
formulas.formula: An algebraic expression is a combination of variables, constants and operations.

formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Like Terms
formulas.formula: Like terms have the same variable raised to the same power (e.g. 2a and 3a).

formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Unlike Terms
formulas.formula: Unlike terms have different variables or powers (e.g. 2a and 3b).

formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Combine Like Terms
formulas.formula: Add or subtract coefficients of like terms: pa ± qa = (p ± q)a

formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Evaluate an Expression
formulas.formula: Substitute the given value of the variable and simplify.

formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Addition / Subtraction Property of Equality
formulas.formula: If a = b, then a ± k = b ± k

formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Multiplication / Division Property of Equality
formulas.formula: If a = b and k ≠ 0, then a × k = b × k and a ÷ k = b ÷ k

formulas.subject: Algebra
formulas.name: Missing Number Problem
formulas.formula: Find the unknown that makes the number sentence true.
